Construction Services in Goddard, KS

Goddard is a growing west Sedgwick County community of roughly 5,000 residents along K-96 and US-54 west of Wichita. The city has seen significant residential growth over the past two decades — its school district reputation and proximity to Wichita while maintaining a small-town feel has attracted family buyers who want newer construction on larger lots.

The housing stock skews newer than much of the metro — the majority of Goddard's residential development has happened since the 1990s, which means the houses are high-quality poured-concrete construction with full basements and builder-grade finishes that are aging into their first major renovation cycle. Wheatland Construction serves Goddard regularly. We permit through the City of Goddard and understand the local residential construction environment.

What We Build in Goddard

Custom Homes

Goddard continues to attract buyers building new custom homes — its active development zones on the west and south edges of town have available lots with Butler County and Sedgwick County access. We build in Goddard from foundation through finish, permitting through the City of Goddard. See Custom Home Building in Goddard →

Home Additions

Goddard's 1990s and 2000s homes are well-built but sized to what buyers wanted then — and many families have outgrown them. Master suite additions, room additions, and bonus space buildouts are common in Goddard's established neighborhoods. We match existing rooflines and finishes precisely. See Home Additions in Goddard →

Basement Finishing

Goddard's newer housing stock has excellent poured-concrete basements — full-depth, good structural integrity, code-compliant rough-in plumbing. The western Sedgwick County soil profile includes clay that creates seasonal moisture pressure, so we assess drainage before framing. Goddard basements in good condition finish into excellent living space. See Basement Finishing in Goddard →

Bathroom Remodeling

Goddard's builder-grade bathrooms from the 1990s and 2000s are now 20 to 30 years old — fiberglass surrounds are fading, cultured marble tops have developed cracks, and the fixtures look dated. We replace them completely: new tile shower or tub surround, new vanity and countertop, new lighting and fixtures, and proper ventilation. See Bathroom Remodeling in Goddard →

Kitchen Remodeling

Goddard's builder-grade kitchens — laminate countertops, basic cabinet boxes, fluorescent lighting, and limited storage — are among the most common remodel requests we get in west Sedgwick County. We upgrade them to a level that matches how Goddard homeowners actually use their kitchens: better layout, better storage, better lighting, and finishes that hold up. See Kitchen Remodeling in Goddard →

Major Remodels

Some Goddard homeowners are doing comprehensive renovations — multiple rooms or full floors updated at once. We manage those scopes with coordinated trades and a single point of contact from permit application through final walkthrough. See Major Remodels in Goddard →

Roofing

West Sedgwick County sees strong southwest wind and spring hail exposure. Goddard's newer construction typically has architectural shingles that are approaching the end of their rated lifespan — and Kansas hail can shorten that lifespan significantly. We handle insurance documentation, City of Goddard permits, and installation. See Roofing in Goddard →

Goddard Permit Office

Residential construction in Goddard permits through the City of Goddard's building department. We handle all permit applications and inspection scheduling.
